definitions.gloss: stomach and intestines; digestive organs; gastrointestinal tract
definitions.explanation: Refers collectively to the stomach and intestines, or more broadly to the digestive system. Commonly used when discussing digestive health.

examples.japanese: {胃腸|いちょう}の{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}い。
{胃腸|いちょう}が{弱|よわ}いので{辛|から}いものは{食|た}べられない。
examples.english: I have a weak stomach, so I can't eat spicy food.

examples.japanese: ストレスで{胃腸|いちょう}の{働|はたら}きが{低下|ていか}することがある。
examples.english: Stress can reduce the functioning of the digestive system.

notes:
USAGE:
{胃腸|いちょう} is the standard everyday term for the digestive tract. Japanese people frequently talk about {胃腸|いちょう} health, especially in relation to stress, seasonal changes, and diet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胃腸|いちょう}が{弱|よわ}い (to have a weak stomach)
- {胃腸|いちょう}の{調子|ちょうし} (condition of the stomach)
- {胃腸|いちょう}{薬|やく} (gastrointestinal medicine)
- {胃腸|いちょう}{炎|えん} (gastroenteritis)
- {胃腸|いちょう}が{丈夫|じょうぶ}だ (to have a strong stomach)
